lazer: read and write the files an economics team works with

Source: R/lazer-package.R
lazer-package.Rd

One place for the readers and writers of day-to-day work. Start here:

Details

  • read_files() reads many files at once in most formats, and can bind them into one table or unpack them as variables.

  • read_workbook() reads every sheet of an Excel workbook, finding the table on each sheet, or the ranges, named ranges or Excel tables you choose. inspect_excel() runs its layout check on its own.

  • write_excel() writes presentable Excel files: bold, frozen header and readable number formats.

  • read_access() reads from a Microsoft Access database.

  • read_ta() and write_ta() read and write Greenlandic TA files in both layouts.

The readers share a few habits: they are quiet when all is well, check what they read, and report every problem in one message instead of stopping at the first.
